design.name: hexa_p80_60kg
design.snapshot_notes: Milestone 8 capstone: 60 kg maximum-takeoff-weight hexacopter on 6x T-Motor P80 III KV100 + G30*10.5 CF props (sourced bench data from the T-Motor product page; 21-row table verified row-by-row: thrust/power = published efficiency and power = V*I). AUW 60.000 kg incl. a 37.7 kg payload block (interpretation: '60 kg drone' = 60 kg MTOW). Rotor reaction torque per thrust 0.0224 N*m/N is SOURCED from the published bench torque column at the hover point (Q/T at 10 kg thrust = 98.1 N). Hexa layout at 0.85 m rotor radius gives 0.85 m adjacent spacing vs 0.762 m prop diameter (9 cm tip clearance). Battery mass/IR, prop mass, ESC rating and frame mass are ESTIMATED (flagged in the component files).
